## Load data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)

intakes_old <- read_csv("data/Intakes_2013_to_2025.csv") |> clean_names()
intakes_new <- read_csv("data/Intakes_20261114.csv") |> clean_names()
outcomes_old <- read_csv("data/Outcomes_2013_to_2025.csv") |> clean_names()
outcomes_new <- read_csv("data/Outcomes_20261114.csv") |> clean_names()

glimpse(intakes_old)
glimpse(outcomes_old)
glimpse(intakes_new)
glimpse(outcomes_new)
```

## Prepare dates

```{r}
to_date <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, c("Date", "POSIXt"))) {
    as_date(x)
  } else {
    as_date(parse_date_time(x, orders = c("YbdIMSp",
                                          "YmdHMS",
                                          "Ymd",
                                          "mdYIMSp")))
  }
}

intakes_old <- intakes_old |>
  mutate(intake_id = row_number(),
         intake_date = to_date(date_time))

outcomes_old_clean <- outcomes_old |>
  transmute(animal_id,
            outcome_date = to_date(date_time),
            outcome_type)

sum(is.na(intakes_old$intake_date))
sum(is.na(outcomes_old_clean$outcome_date))
range(intakes_old$intake_date)

intakes_old |> count(year = year(intake_date))
```

## Prepare outcomes 

```{r}
outcomes_all <- outcomes_old_clean |>
  mutate(outcome_type = str_to_lower(outcome_type)) |>
  distinct()

outcomes_all |> count(outcome_type, sort = TRUE)

# Confirm where each old file ends
max(intakes_old$intake_date)
max(outcomes_all$outcome_date)
```

## Build the stays table

```{r}
# Step 1: pair each intake with its next outcome
matched <- intakes_old |>
  select(intake_id, animal_id, intake_date) |>
  inner_join(outcomes_all, by = "animal_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  filter(outcome_date >= intake_date) |>
  group_by(intake_id) |>
  slice_min(outcome_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(intake_id, outcome_date, outcome_type)

# Step 2: add those outcomes back onto every intake
data_cutoff <- as_date("2025-05-05")

stays <- intakes_old |>
  left_join(matched, by = "intake_id") |>
  mutate(still_in_shelter = is.na(outcome_date),
         end_date = coalesce(outcome_date, data_cutoff),
         los_days = as.numeric(end_date - intake_date))
```

## Sanity check

```{r}
stays |>
  count(still_in_shelter)

stays |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            negative_stays = sum(los_days < 0),
            median_los = median(los_days))

stays |> arrange(desc(los_days)) |>
  select(animal_id,
         intake_date,
         outcome_date,
         los_days)
```

## Investigate unmatched stays

```{r}
# 1. How long ago did the unmatched animals arrive?
stays |>
  filter(still_in_shelter) |>
  mutate(wait_group = case_when(
    los_days <= 30  ~ "30 days or less",
    los_days <= 365 ~ "31 to 365 days",
    TRUE            ~ "over a year")) |>
  count(wait_group)

# 2. What kinds of animals are they?
stays |>
  filter(still_in_shelter) |>
  count(animal_type, sort = TRUE)

# 3. How common are very long stays among matched animals?
stays |>
  filter(!still_in_shelter) |>
  summarise(over_90_days = sum(los_days > 90),
            share_over_90 = mean(los_days > 90),
            over_1_year = sum(los_days > 365))
```

## Clean data and group outcomes

```{r}
stays_clean <- stays |>
  filter(animal_type %in% c("Dog", "Cat")) |>
  filter(!(still_in_shelter & los_days > 365)) |>
  mutate(outcome_group = case_when(still_in_shelter ~ "Still in shelter",
                                   is.na(outcome_type) ~ "Unknown outcome",
                                   outcome_type == "adoption" ~ "Adopted",
                                   outcome_type %in% c("return to owner",
                                          "rto-adopt") ~ "Returned to owner",
                                   outcome_type == "transfer" ~ "Transferred",
                                   outcome_type == "euthanasia" ~ "Euthanized",
                                   TRUE ~ "Other outcome"))

nrow(stays_clean)
stays_clean |>
  count(outcome_group, sort = TRUE)
stays_clean |>
  count(animal_type, outcome_group) |>
  arrange(animal_type, desc(n))
```
